historic_survey.note: A rectangular-plan commercial building completely remodelled in 1937-38 in the Streamline Moderne idiom: the corners rounded, continuous corner windows installed, rustic wood cladding covered with smooth enamel iron panels, speed lines applied near the roofline, and the entrance rebuilt with a recessed vestibule, terrazzo paving and a marquee tower.

historical_record.description: Remodelled over 1937 and 1938 into the Streamline Moderne: the corners rounded off, continuous windows run around them, the rustic wood cladding covered over with smooth enamel iron panels, speed lines laid in near the roofline, and the entrance rebuilt with a recessed vestibule, terrazzo paving and a marquee tower.

Completely remodelled in 1937-38 in the Streamline Moderne manner: the corners rounded, continuous corner windows put in, the rustic wood cladding covered with smooth enamelled iron panels, speed lines run under the roofline, and the entrance rebuilt with a recessed vestibule, terrazzo paving and a marquee tower.
